ShortDescription.Value: Customize city starting budget and milestones, add automatic budget support, and convert Unlimited Money saves.

Publish.LongDescription:
### Budget + Milestones
Customize city-start progression and budget without changing City Watchdog's visual/HUD features.
#### City Start - Choose the starting money balance for the next loaded limited-money city. - Choose a higher milestone to unlock when the next city loads. - Milestone rewards use the game's own milestone values and unlock events.
#### Budget - Add or subtract a selected amount with hotkeys. - Optional Automatic Add Money can keep the city above a selected threshold.
#### Unlimited Money Converter - Convert a city created with Unlimited Money into normal limited-money budgeting. - Make a backup save first. The conversion cannot be undone by the mod.
No Harmony patch.
